description:
Did you know you can publish a real, working website for free using GitHub Pages? Whether you are building with Jekyll, Astro, or Next.js, you can turn your repository into a live site in just a few clicks. It is the perfect place to host your portfolio, resume, or side project. Watch to see how easy it is to set up, and check out GitHub for Beginners season 3 for more tips!
